text.p: (in millions of French francs, unless stated)
NOTE - Easdaq listed Chemunex SA is a French life sciences company. * Company said the third quarter results unaudited
Chemunex also provided the following unaudited results for nine months to March 31, 1997
(in millions of French francs, unless stated)

In a statement, Chemunex said sales for the quarter compared with the year-earlier period rose more than 150 percent to 3.9 million French francs, while nine month sales were up more than 90 percent to 12.2 million francs. Margins also rose.

Chief executive Louis Foissac said shipment volumes of its ChemScan product for the full-year to June 30 were likely to be in line with expectations, although a mix of sales and rentals may lead to slightly lower than expected revenues.
"It is anticipated that Chemunex's net losses for the full year will be slightly higher than estimated," he said.
